findings.description: Every ATD_STAGE2A_STATE line of this group shows "ability": {"GET_INTO_BOAT/GET_INTO_MINECART": null}: the probe's abilities map does not contain this ability, so the server-side lock state is never logged directly. The lock is proven indirectly (count = threshold-1 from the runtime config, server action-bar overlay, absent effect, denial side effects). Verdicts remain reproducible, but the brief's statement that STATE shows the tested ability's lock state does not hold here.

No interaction packet or explicit plugin decision line is logged for the mount route (ServerboundInteractPacket not traced, EntityMountEvent not logged). Server-side denial is inferred from the updateInventory packets and server action-bar text only.
